import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long n;
    static long cnt1 = 0;
    static long[] sum = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] v = new ArrayList[10];
    static long cnt2 = 0;
    static long ans = 0;
    static int[] pw = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long readLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long a = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int s;
        while (true) {
            s = br.read();
            if (s == -1) break;
            if (s == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(s)) {
                a = s - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            s = br.read();
            if (s == -1 || !Character.isDigit(s)) break;
            a = a * 10 + (s - '0');
        }
        return a * sign;
    }

    static void dfs1(int len, long val) {
        if (len > 6) return;
        long temp = (cnt1 - val + mod1) % mod1;
        v[len].add(temp);
        sum[len] += temp;
        cnt1++;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n;
    }

    static void dfs2(int len, long val) {
        if (val > n) return;
        if (check(val)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long v1 = ((cnt2 + 1 - val * pw[i]) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
                int num = lowerBound(v[i], (mod1 - v1));
                long tempSum = sum[i] + v[i].size() * v1 - mod1 * (v[i].size() - num);
                ans = (ans + tempSum) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
        } else {
            if (len != 0) {
                cnt2++;
            }
            long tempAns = ((cnt2 - val) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
            ans = (ans + tempAns) % mod2;
            for (int i = (len == 0 ? 0 : 0); i <= 9; i++) {
                dfs2(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
